summary: Glenveagh Properties PLC, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction and sale of houses and apartments for private buyers, local authorities, and the private rental sector in Ireland. It operates through Homebuilding and Partnerships segments. The company develops own-door single-family properties in Dublin, the Greater Dublin Area, and Cork; and suburban single-family focused and urban multi-family focused properties. It also provides financing and manufacturing services. Glenveagh Properties PLC was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Maynooth, Ireland.
